_comment: Phrase rules an explainer chapter keeps IN ADDITION to every rule in history/lint-rules.json (tools/_hw.lint_rules(project) appends these). Same shape as the base file. Patterns are compiled case-insensitive and run on the prose with quotations blanked.

rules.why: a label in place of the mechanism. Say how it works, what it costs and where it stops, and let that impress the reader (voice.md §8)
'obviously' and 'simply' tell a newcomer the step they need is beneath mention. Give the step, or cut the word (voice.md §8)
a model computes; it does not think, know or want. Keep the shorthand only when the next sentence says what it really does (voice.md §8)
